reason: All three Discovery pipelines reached terminal coverage for the run date. Discovery retained material same-day signals but performed no Queue triage.
reason_zh: 运行日三条 Discovery 管线均完成终态覆盖。Discovery 仅保留当天重要信号，未执行 Queue 筛选。

pipelines.label: AI Platform Change Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: AI 平台变更情报发现
pipelines.reason: All 45 due public P0 channels were inspected. No material same-day platform announcement or documentation change was retained independently after cross-pipeline normalization; repository-origin changes were represented once in GitHub Engineering where primary maintainer evidence was stronger.
pipelines.reason_zh: 45 个到期的公开 P0 渠道全部完成检查。跨管线规范化后，没有单独保留当天重要的平台公告或文档变更；源自仓库的变化统一在 GitHub Engineering 中以更强的一手维护者证据记录。

pipelines.label: GitHub Engineering Intelligence
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 daily repositories were inspected incrementally. Fourteen same-day maintainer changes were normalized into material engineering signals; repositories without a qualifying same-day change were recorded as checked with no retained signal.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 Daily 仓库全部完成增量检查。当天维护者变更经规范化后形成 14 个重要工程信号；没有符合条件当天变化的仓库记录为已检查但不保留信号。

pipelines.label: Published Research Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: 论文与研究成果情报发现
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 research sources were queried. One same-day Zenodo primary research artifact met the configured enterprise-governance scope; other visible items were older, out of scope, or lacked sufficient same-day freshness to retain as signals.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 研究来源全部完成查询。1 个当天发布的 Zenodo 一手研究产物符合企业治理范围；其余可见内容发布时间更早、超出范围，或缺少足够的当天新鲜度，因此未保留为信号。

columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.reason: Discovery retained four primary Digital Employee signals. No Selection is a schema-compatible Discovery-stage marker only; Queue triage remains pending.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 保留 4 个以数字员工为主栏目的信号。No Selection 仅作为符合 Schema 的 Discovery 阶段标记；Queue 筛选仍待执行。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery retained two primary Industry Architecture signals. No Selection is a schema-compatible Discovery-stage marker only; Queue triage remains pending.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 保留 2 个以行业架构为主栏目的信号。No Selection 仅作为符合 Schema 的 Discovery 阶段标记；Queue 筛选仍待执行。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery retained nine primary Open-source Engineering signals. No Selection is a schema-compatible Discovery-stage marker only; Queue triage remains pending.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 保留 9 个以开源工程为主栏目的信号。No Selection 仅作为符合 Schema 的 Discovery 阶段标记；Queue 筛选仍待执行。

signals.title: Codex app server adds persistent thread queue APIs with automatic FIFO dispatch
signals.title_zh: Codex App Server 新增持久 Thread Queue API 与自动 FIFO 派发
signals.summary: The app server adds persistent queued user submissions, CRUD/reorder/start operations, change notifications, stable IDs, and automatic FIFO dispatch after completed or failed turns while remaining paused after interruption.
signals.summary_zh: App Server 增加持久化用户提交队列、增删改排与启动操作、变更通知和稳定 ID，并在 Turn 完成或失败后自动 FIFO 派发；中断后保持暂停。

signals.title: Codex preserves thread subscriptions across revert reloads
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Revert Reload 后保留 Thread Subscription
signals.summary: Thread listeners are restarted from preserved thread state after paginated reloads instead of depending on the requesting connection, protecting existing subscriptions when that connection closes.
signals.summary_zh: 分页重载后，Thread Listener 从保留的 Thread State 重启，而不再依赖发起请求的连接，从而在该连接关闭时仍保护既有订阅。

signals.title: Codex skill metadata now carries supported model annotations
signals.title_zh: Codex Skill Metadata 开始携带受支持的模型标注
signals.summary: Skill frontmatter parsing adds an optional model field, recognizes supported model values, and ignores unsupported values without preventing the remaining skill metadata from loading.
signals.summary_zh: Skill Frontmatter 解析新增可选 model 字段，识别受支持模型值，同时忽略不支持值而不阻塞其余 Skill Metadata 加载。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK redacts tool output values from output-type validation errors
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 从输出类型校验错误中隐藏工具输出值
signals.summary: Tool output values are no longer exposed in output-type validation errors, tightening failure-path data handling.
signals.summary_zh: 输出类型校验错误不再暴露工具输出值，强化失败路径中的数据处理边界。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK snapshots sandbox policy and proxy request state per operation
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 按操作快照 Sandbox Policy 与 Proxy 请求状态
signals.summary: A sandbox fix snapshots per-operation audit policies; an adjacent same-day maintainer fix also snapshots HTTP proxy headers, indicating explicit operation-scoped state capture for concurrent execution paths.
signals.summary_zh: Sandbox 修复按操作快照 Audit Policy；同日相邻维护者修复同时快照 HTTP Proxy Header，体现并发执行路径中显式的操作级状态捕获。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK fixes Codex resume argument ordering
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 修复 Codex Resume 参数顺序
signals.summary: The Codex integration now preserves resume argument ordering, a narrow but directly relevant recovery/resumption correctness fix.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 集成现在保留 Resume 参数顺序，是直接涉及恢复与续跑正确性的修复。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.232 makes subagent forking default and expands cross-session messaging
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.232 默认启用 Subagent Forking 并扩展跨 Session 消息
signals.summary: The release enables fork-style subagents by default, backgrounds non-teammate spawns in interactive sessions, adds named cross-session messaging, and exposes inbound message acceptance controls.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本默认启用 Fork 型 Subagent，交互会话中的非队友 Spawn 默认后台运行，并新增命名跨 Session 消息与入站消息接受控制。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.232 hardens permissions, repository trust, sandbox paths, and shared messaging sockets
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.232 强化权限、仓库信任、Sandbox 路径与共享消息 Socket
signals.summary: The release closes multiple permission and sandbox bypasses, requires trust per nested repository, protects cross-session messaging socket directories, and restricts sandbox binary overrides to higher-precedence settings.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本关闭多项权限与 Sandbox 绕过，要求嵌套仓库分别确认信任，保护跨 Session 消息 Socket 目录，并把 Sandbox 二进制覆盖限制在更高优先级设置层。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.232 strengthens Remote Control reattachment, restart recovery, and reconnect persistence
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.232 强化 Remote Control 重连、重启恢复与持续重试
signals.summary: Remote Control sessions reattach to existing sessions after local resume, restore conversation history after worker restarts, surface reachability correctly to new clients, and keep reconnecting for roughly 30 minutes after network loss.
signals.summary_zh: Remote Control 在本地 Resume 后重新附着既有 Session，在 Worker 重启后恢复会话历史，向新客户端正确暴露可达性，并在网络中断后持续重连约 30 分钟。

signals.title: Gemini CLI rolls back the entire multi-turn request on cancellation or abort
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在取消或中止时回滚整个多 Turn 请求
signals.summary: Cancellation and abort handling now rolls back the entire multi-turn request rather than leaving partial request state behind.
signals.summary_zh: 取消与中止处理现在回滚整个多 Turn 请求，避免留下部分请求状态。

signals.title: Gemini CLI adds context-aware silent retries and availability TTL for capacity errors
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 为容量错误新增上下文感知静默重试与可用性 TTL
signals.summary: Capacity-error handling adds context-aware silent retries and a time-bounded availability cache, making retry behavior stateful and explicitly bounded.
signals.summary_zh: 容量错误处理新增上下文感知静默重试和有时限的可用性缓存，使重试行为具有状态且边界明确。

signals.title: Google ADK fixes systemic first-part assumptions in Gemini Live flows
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复 Gemini Live Flow 中系统性的首 Part 假设
signals.summary: Core Gemini Live connection and flow modules now scan all message parts instead of assuming the relevant content is always at parts[0].
signals.summary_zh: 核心 Gemini Live Connection 与 Flow 模块现在扫描全部消息 Part，不再假设相关内容始终位于 parts[0]。

signals.title: Google ADK resolves nested providers behind litellm_proxy prefixes
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 正确解析 litellm_proxy 前缀后的嵌套 Provider
signals.summary: Provider resolution now recognizes nested providers behind litellm_proxy prefixes so provider-specific behavior such as Azure file upload handling is not skipped.
signals.summary_zh: Provider 解析现在识别 litellm_proxy 前缀后的嵌套 Provider，避免 Azure 文件上传等 Provider 特定行为被跳过。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves developer instructions when invocation event history is empty
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Invocation Event 为空时仍保留 Developer Instructions
signals.summary: Prompt assembly now populates developer instructions even when invocation_events is empty, closing an initialization-state gap in instruction propagation.
signals.summary_zh: Prompt Assembly 在 invocation_events 为空时仍填充 Developer Instructions，修复初始化状态中的指令传播缺口。

signals.title: DPX-G360 proposes an accountable-AI governance architecture for airline digital operations
signals.title_zh: DPX-G360 提出面向航空数字运营的可问责 AI 治理架构
signals.summary: The same-day Zenodo artifact presents a design-science architecture combining accountable AI, trusted data, integrated enterprise systems, KPI governance, and operational resilience across airline front-stage and back-stage functions.
signals.summary_zh: 该当天 Zenodo 研究产物提出设计科学架构，把可问责 AI、可信数据、企业系统集成、KPI 治理与运营韧性连接到航空前台与后台职能。
